executive_summary: Binding forensic audit, fixed controls and interpretation before new diagnostic outcomes. Parent results already exposed.
PRICE_FULL: Exact parent saved probabilities and saved models; NEVER refit
primary_ledger: Exact original parent scored_rows.parquet, all valid rows unchanged
target: sign(truth-original V51 median), zeros excluded from fitting only, zero predictions no sign credit
folds: Exactly inherited folds(), actual+weekday planned maturity before firsttest previousweekday cutoff; test release exclusion preserved

nulls.intercept: Unpenalized intercept-only logistic MLE probability equals train positive frequency; no dummy features, C irrelevant
nulls.asset_prior: Train perasset majority, missing group pooled train majority
nulls.horizon_prior: Train perhorizon majority, missing group pooled train majority

lag_rule: Shift original price_observation_date back fixed5/21/63 weekdays, choose last price index<=date; same14-vector transformation; all controls same folds/rows, no future lookup

permutation.unit: Full14-vector at unique TRAIN origin, broadcast to all asset/horizon rows. Preserve asset/logH and targets. All donors already observed and matured by fold cutoff; heldout input unchanged
permutation.clarification: Fold-conditional historical-origin permutation, not pretend as-of feature states at donor recipient historical timestamps. No heldout/future donor.

random.method: Permute original PRICE_FULL signs within specified groups, preserve exact +/-/tie counts. No targets accepted by generator.

bootstrap.random_median: Recompute median of5000 overall-matched random vector scores in every block resample

aggregation: Normalized scorer ratio of weighted sums. Origin/year equal total weight; weighted Spearman via weighted midranks; parent unweighted Spearman preserved. No IID bootstrap.
concentration: Largest positive group-sum gain / sum of positive group-sum gains, year/origin/horizon; no removals

acceptance.PRICE_SIGNAL_REAL_BUT_SMALL: All user gates: ratio<=.990, increments intercept&structure>=.003, beatsmajority&randommedian, balanced>=.55, Spearman>=.10, at least4/5years<=1, permutationp<=.05, origin/year95%ratioCIupper<1, largestyeargrossgain<=.5, PIT A/B
acceptance.persistent_bias: At least3/5 folds train and test same majority direction with both frequencies>=5pp from50%, same nonzero raw mean-error sign; trainmajority ratio<1
acceptance.similar_null: Any fixedconstant/majority/intercept abs ratio difference<=.003 or null lower ratio
acceptance.material_real_PIT_limited: ratio<1; bothincrements>=.003; balanced>=.55;Spearman>=.10; at least3years<1; permutationp<=.05; PIT C/D
acceptance.priority: User A, then B ifpersistentbias and similar/frequent/negligible, then C materialreal&PITlimited, then D ifno persistentbias/no permutation support/frequentrandom and weakoriginbalanced or <3good years, else E INCONCLUSIVE. Exactly one next axis from fixed decision implementation.

broader_transfer: Blocked before outcome access because PIT C. Canonical specification frozen; no transfer fit
public_private_firewall: Only aggregate losses/metrics and outcome-free predictions public; truth/draws/cellloss/private targets never Git
